grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Week 8 Listening: Past, Plans and Review
instructions: 这是为第8周A1水平学习者设计的听力练习。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答8个问题。问题包括单选题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过规定字数。所有题目均为直接信息题，不需要推理。注意：本材料为模拟教育内容，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript: A: Hi, Mei. Where were you yesterday? B: I was at the library. A: Was it busy? B: No, it wasn't. It was quiet. A: What are you going to do tomorrow? B: I'm going to visit my grandmother because it's her birthday. A: That's nice. I'm going to study English because I have a test next week. B: Good luck! A: Thanks. Were you good at English in school? B: No, I wasn't. But now I like it. A: Me too. I was at the English club last week. B: Was it fun? A: Yes, it was. We were all beginners. B: I'm going to join a club because I want to practice. A: Great! The club is going to meet on Friday.

questions.explanation: 录音中Mei说：'I was at the library.' 所以她在图书馆。
Mei说：'No, it wasn't. It was quiet.' 说明图书馆不忙。
questions.evidence: No, it wasn't. It was quiet.

questions.prompt: Mei明天打算做什么？请用原文单词填空：She is going to ______ her grandmother.
questions.explanation: Mei说：'I'm going to visit my grandmother'，所以填visit。
questions.evidence: I'm going to visit my grandmother

questions.explanation: Mei说：'because it's her birthday'，所以是因为祖母的生日。

questions.prompt: 另一个人（A）明天打算做什么？
questions.explanation: A说：'I'm going to study English'，所以A打算学习英语。
A问：'Were you good at English in school?' B回答：'No, I wasn't.' 但这里问的是A，A说：'Me too.' 表示A也不擅长。但更直接的是，A问B，B说不擅长，A说Me too，所以A也不擅长。但题目问A，根据对话，A说Me too，所以A不擅长。
questions.evidence: B: No, I wasn't. But now I like it. A: Me too.

questions.prompt: A上周在哪里？请用原文单词填空：I was at the English ______ last week.
questions.explanation: A说：'I was at the English club last week.' 所以填club。
questions.evidence: I was at the English club last week.

questions.prompt: 英语俱乐部什么时候聚会？
questions.explanation: A说：'The club is going to meet on Friday.' 所以是星期五。
questions.evidence: The club is going to meet on Friday.

vocabulary.example: I'm going to visit my grandmother.
I was at the English club last week.

grammar.title: 过去时was/were与be going to
grammar.explanation: 我们用was/were谈论过去。I/he/she/it用was，you/we/they用were。否定形式：was not (wasn't), were not (weren't)。我们用be going to谈论计划。例如：I am going to study. 我们还用because说明原因。
grammar.example: I was at the library. I'm going to visit my grandmother because it's her birthday.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I ______ at home yesterday.
选择正确的单词填空：They ______ happy last night.
选择正确的单词填空：She ______ going to cook dinner.
questions.explanation: 主语是She，be going to结构用is。
questions.evidence: I'm going to visit my grandmother.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：I like English ______ it is fun.

part1: What are you going to do tomorrow?
Were you at school last week?
speaking.part2: Describe a past event or a future plan. You should say:
part3: What did you do last weekend?
Are you going to study English this week?

transfer.writing: Write 2-8 simple sentences about what you did yesterday and what you are going to do tomorrow. Use was/were and be going to. Example: Yesterday I was at home. I was happy. Tomorrow I am going to study English because I have a test.
